title: Creatify Pricing: Plans, Studio and Alternatives
summary: Creatify offers self-service AI ad tools and a managed Studio. Compare current plans, credits, production ownership, and the work needed to approve an ad.
body_markdown:
## How should you compare Platform and Studio using one brief?


Give both routes the same desired batch. For the coffee example, the brief might contain an opening about choosing a roast, another about the delivery routine, and a common product explanation. Specify whether those are two independent concepts or variants of one idea. Include required formats, approved facts, final-file expectations and the person who can approve changes.


In the Platform route, assign an internal owner for every step: preparing inputs, choosing a treatment, generating, editing, reviewing and exporting. In the Studio route, ask the proposal to identify which of those steps the team performs and what it needs from you. Studio's published process makes it a managed-production candidate; the final proposal determines the actual responsibility split.


Use one ordinary correction to test the handoff. For example, change an approved delivery phrase before final approval and ask what must be revised. This reveals the practical process more clearly than asking whether revisions are “easy.” It should not be used to manufacture rework after an agreed sign-off; the aim is to understand a realistic correction within the pilot scope.


Pilot output Software route Managed route


Approved script Record who drafts and checks it Confirm the approval handoff


First cut Record setup, generation and editing work Confirm the team's delivery responsibilities


Factual correction Measure the work needed to fix it Resolve correction versus new-scope rules


Final export Inspect the actual usable file Inspect against the same acceptance standard


Next-batch feedback Assign an owner to turn results into a brief Confirm how feedback reaches production


Do not grade the routes by identical button presses. Compare the usable result and work that remains with your team. A managed workflow can be attractive because it assigns ownership; software can be attractive because it preserves direct control. Neither conclusion requires an unsupported performance ranking.


## When should you stop generating and change the treatment?


Set an iteration limit for the pilot before starting. If the same product action remains inaccurate, switch to approved real footage or a simpler presentation rather than treating unlimited attempts as the only route to an ad. If the voice delivery is unsuitable, isolate whether the issue is the script, pronunciation, pacing or selected treatment. Record the reason before another generation.


The stopping rule protects the evaluation from becoming an unbounded creative project. It also helps compare plans: a larger credit allowance matters differently when the current process is reliable than when the team is still searching for a usable approach. Use your own observations to estimate next month's work rather than assuming every credit produces an accepted scene.


Before adopting the output, resolve usage rights for uploaded images, music, presenter assets and any material supplied by contractors. This article does not establish that every element available through a workflow has identical licensing terms. Keep the relevant agreement with the asset and identify who approves its use in your campaign.


For an alternative that includes campaign ownership, Knowlify offers creative production and end-to-end Meta campaign management together. Creative-only delivery is also available for an existing buyer. Pricing is provided privately and media spend is separate. Compare that agreement with a Studio production proposal only after identifying which campaign responsibilities each proposal includes; do not assign a management capability to another vendor based solely on its ability to produce finished videos.


## How should you compare alternatives fairly?


Compare software against software and managed production against managed production, using the same brief. For the software side,[Arcads' avatar workflow](https://www.arcads.ai/features/ai-avatars) is an alternative to evaluate; our[Creatify versus Arcads comparison](https://knowlify.com/articles/creatify-vs-arcads) lays out a shared pilot.


For managed work, Knowlify's[video ad production](https://knowlify.com/video-ad-production) and[creative subscription](https://knowlify.com/creative-as-a-service) cover concept through final render. Our[AI UGC service](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) describes one of the available formats. Knowlify also offers end-to-end Meta campaign management alongside creative production, with creative-only work available. Pricing is private and media spend is separate.


Our suggested decision rule is based on ownership. Use software when your team wants to direct and finish the work. Evaluate a service when the desired purchase is a delivered batch with a named team responsible for production. Neither choice guarantees better ad performance.


Bring a real brief to[a production call](https://knowlify.com/book) , including one asset your team rejected and the reason. Ask each provider how its workflow would address that specific problem. That discussion is more useful than comparing selected demo reels without the original constraints.


## Key takeaways


- Creatify Platform and Studio are different purchases.
- Confirm billing and credit consumption against the task you intend to run.
- Match your scope through an[approval workflow](https://knowlify.com/articles/video-ad-approval-workflow) before comparing managed vendors.


## FAQ


### Is Creatify entirely self-service?


No.[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) is a managed production offer. The Platform subscription and Studio service should be compared separately because the production responsibilities included in each purchase are different.


### How much does Creatify cost?


Use the dated Platform table above as a snapshot of the annual display, then confirm current billing and usage in[Creatify's pricing](https://creatify.ai/pricing) . Obtain a separate proposal for Studio instead of applying a software rate to managed production.


### Does Creatify guarantee better ad performance?


This review does not establish a performance guarantee or reproduce vendor case-study outcomes as expected results. Evaluate any contractual promise in the proposed agreement and test approved creative against your own campaign objective.


### Who should consider Knowlify instead?


Consider Knowlify when you want creative production and Meta campaign management together, or recurring creative-only delivery to an existing buyer. Compare a private proposal with the same concepts, variants, review process and account responsibilities. Media spend is separate, and this comparison does not claim a tested cost or quality advantage over Creatify.


### Can I publish a Creatify URL-to-video draft without reviewing it?


Review the script, selected assets, product version and offer before treating a draft as approved. Compare each claim with your source material, then inspect the final edit and required rights. A product-page input is a starting point for production, not evidence that every generated phrase or visual is appropriate for your campaign.
